instruction: Set the font color of titles in slides 2 and 5 to blue (#0000FF) and make them bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing title color to blue (#0000FF) and making them bold in slides 2 and 5. Evaluator extracts both color and bold properties and gives partial credit (0.5 per property per slide).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 = Both titles have correct color AND bold, 0.75 = Both have one property correct, 0.5 = One title fully correct or both partially correct, 0.25 = Minimal progress, 0.0 = No changes
metadata.verification: Verified by analyzing actual PowerPoint file structure: file contains 6 slides with titles in Gloria Hallelujah and Poppins fonts. Target slides identified based on slide indices.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: color (#0000FF) and bold for titles in slides 2 and 5
Slide index conversion is correct: human-readable slides 2,5 map to 0-indexed array [1,4]
Postconfig properly saves file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring getter reads current state
Partial credit logic is sensible: 1 point for color + 1 point for bold per slide (total 4 points)
Getter extracts title properties correctly using largest font size heuristic
Metric comparison handles both exact color match and tolerance-based RGB comparison (default tolerance: 20)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter output format matches metric input expectations
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Title identification uses 'largest font size' heuristic which may fail if multiple shapes have same max size or title isn't largest text. Consider checking shape type or placeholder type if available.
Minor: Getter only checks first run of first paragraph - doesn't verify if ALL title text has consistent formatting (mixed formatting edge case not handled)
